name: diagramforce
works_with: Claude (Cowork, Claude Code, claude.ai) and the free Diagramforce web app
short: Turns a description, screenshot, draw.io or Mermaid file, or real Salesforce Flow metadata into a diagram you open in Diagramforce.
what: Diagramforce is a free browser app for Salesforce architecture diagrams, data models, Data Cloud field mappings, Flows, org charts, Gantt charts and sequence diagrams. This skill writes diagram JSON for it, checks it with a bundled validator and hands you a link or a file. Given a real Flow's `.flow-meta.xml` or Tooling API response, it converts the actual flow, decision outcomes and fault paths included, instead of redrawing it.
who: Salesforce architects, consultants and admins who document orgs. It is for diagrams only, so skip it if you need data charts or dashboards.
needs: Node, for the bundled converter and validator scripts
Optional: an authenticated Salesforce CLI, to link a diagram to the real flow
Optional: a Chromium-family browser, to render PNG or SVG images

steps.title: Add the skill
steps.text: The skill lives in the repo's `cowork-skill/diagramforce` folder. The README gives no install command, so add that folder to your AI app's skills the usual way.

steps.title: Ask for a diagram
steps.text: Describe it, or hand over a screenshot, a draw.io file or Mermaid source. If you have Mermaid, you can also paste it straight into the app.

steps.title: Convert a real Flow
steps.text: Give it the SFDX source file or a Tooling API response. It runs the converter, then the validator.
steps.code:
node scripts/flow-to-diagramforce.mjs force-app/main/default/flows/My_Flow.flow-meta.xml diagram.json
node scripts/validate-diagram.mjs diagram.json

steps.title: Open it
steps.text: Click the diagramforce.com link it gives you. For a big diagram it gives you a file instead: open diagramforce.com, click Load, choose Paste and paste the JSON, or open the file from the File tab.

try.label: From the README
try.text: "Turn this into an ERD" with a screenshot of a data model, or "diagram this Flow from my org".

watch: The project gives no install command for the skill.
With `--org`, the converter uses your logged-in Salesforce CLI to read the org.
A share link carries the whole diagram in the URL, so anyone with the link can see it.
Google Drive sync is opt-in. Once connected, auto-save is on by default, every 2 minutes.
Workbench, one way to fetch Flow metadata, is a third-party tool that some orgs block.
